source_evidence: Exact player 'Hess, coordinate with Voss to restore my roads and mine and estate. I will send whatever coin you need. We will return to Orsaven to legally reclaim our property.' reinforces D344 joint restoration mandate and directs return to Orsaven to pursue lawful property claims. At D344~16:20 Hessa accepts direct instructions to coordinate with Voss, actively progress road/access, Silverward mine prospect, ancestral residence and regional development, arrange competent assessments, contractor quotes, viable phased work, funding requests and actual follow-through without routine approval loops. She may use her existing authorized Silverward funds for their designated scope; V's promise to send needed coin is not an immediate transfer or unlimited spend authority, no amount specified, no new debt/cross-estate pooling or unverified land/mineral rights. Hessa adds written clarification for Voss to previously accepted carrier's sealed forwarding consignment with carrier assent at existing2gp bundled charge; no extra fee or disclosure of private originals. Existing D344 estate handoff HANDOFF-D344-ESTATES-ANCESTRAL-SEAT-COORDINATED-DEVELOPMENT-001 covers this work, avoid duplicate requests/outcomes; actual Voss receipt not yet verified. Mara gathers copies of D326 conditional Silverward recovery instrument and recovered historical/physical evidence, Caul signed relinquishment (V retains original), tower handover evidence, measured seat plan, dedication/tablet and manor register copies for lawful hereditary claims; no new title or appropriation. D344→345 Hessa household willingly hosts one protected overnight inside occupied dwelling under established guardians' watch, no new fee, own rations/feed already D344 charged; qualifying secure-household night LR3→5/6, no HD spend, all HP/pools full. D345 dawn routine Tamsin contact, carrier observed leaving on existing eastbound route with Voss and Coris packets; onward delivery/payment remain unverified. D347~16:00 party visits same royal land-records office under previous D326 actual grant, presents original signed conditional recovery instrument and Caul relinquishment for inspection, Mara provides duplicate evidence packet and measured sketches; originals retained by V/Mara. Officer accepts and records substantive combined applications: final Silverward deed under already agreed zero-price conditional recovery grant (actual parcel and ledge/structural safety clearance still to be evidenced; resident/public rights preserved); western tower hereditary recovery/recognition claim based on Caul's relinquishment and possession; ancestral seat hereditary recognition/recovery claim based on independently corroborated named allocation and measured remains; associated land boundaries, road/access/easements, woodland/quarry/mineral rights to be established by actual registry and ground survey rather than assumed blanket title. Officer agrees to coordinate ordinary Crown parcel/condition inspection and title research across these sites with Hessa/Voss when contact feasible, without arbitrary repeat personal application or requiring full reconstruction. No actual surveyor visit, completed current-title adjudication, new conditional grant beyond D326, deed, legal sovereignty, toll monopoly, mine concession, fee, sale, or additional coin authorization yet. Officer states no need for V to accompany routine field verification; if a competing right or genuine substantive claim emerges, it will be identified and handled. Officer accepts supporting copies into actual office custody and provides dated acknowledgment, not deed. No new roll for routine filing and ordinary officer cooperation, no extra expense. No new estate commercial outcomes, Coris receipt/reward, Voss response, or other correspondence inferred. V next decision at Orsaven land-records office ~16:20; other estate/quest/custody facts preserved.
